Operator decision (2026-08-19): APPROVED — model the predicate with an operator-tagged union / dataclass per operator family, exactly as the description's Approach proposes. Do NOT widen to `value: Any`, and do NOT reach for cast().

Rationale: `value: object` produces 7 real mypy errors in the body and `Any` would satisfy the ratchet while buying neither navigability nor a contract driver — the documented failure mode on cc77-8120-bcc6-47e8. The tagged union is the only option that actually buys the contract, because the operator and its value shape travel together and the body narrows by construction. An @overload-on-operator-literal alternative was considered: it introduces less new vocabulary but still leaves the body needing narrowing, so it solves less for comparable effort.

Blast radius is contained: there are only two callers to update (reducer/_query.py and apply_ticket_filters), which is what makes this affordable.
